findings.title: Harvests on the "To" date are left out of the stats
findings.steps: Sample data has a 150 g Lettuce harvest on 2026-09-30. On /stats, set To = 2026-09-30 (or call /api/stats/harvests?from=2026-09-30&to=2026-09-30).
findings.expected: The range includes its last day: 5 harvests, Lettuce 350 g, a Sept 2026 column; the single-day query returns that harvest.
findings.actual: The page says '4 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 30 Sept 2026', Lettuce shows 200 g and there is no Sept column. The single-day query returns no plants and harvest_count 0, and the page shows 'No harvests in this range'.
findings.evidence: stats.py uses `h.harvested_on >= ? AND h.harvested_on < ?` (excludes the To date) in both the main query and top_plants. Seen in the UI text and the API JSON.

findings.title: Dashboard top plant skips 31 December harvests, but the dashboard total counts them
findings.where: GET /api/dashboard/summary, dashboard 'Top plant this year' card
findings.steps: On 31 Dec, log a harvest dated today that would make a different plant the heaviest. Open the dashboard.
findings.expected: The top plant and its grams use the same full-year range as harvest_grams_year (1 Jan to 31 Dec inclusive).
findings.actual: top_plants(conn, year_from, year_to) uses `< '…-12-31'`, so 31 Dec harvests are left out of the top plant, while harvest_grams_year still uses BETWEEN and includes them. The card can name the wrong plant and weight.
findings.evidence: Code: dashboard.py now calls top_plants, which has the exclusive upper bound. Couldn't reproduce today because harvests dated in the future are refused.

findings.title: Stats error state has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/stats/harvests return 500 (mocked), then open Stats from the nav or directly.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that fetches again.
findings.actual: Only the text 'Could not load harvest stats.' appears. There is no retry control, so the only way to recover is to change a date or reload.
findings.evidence: Page text after the mocked 500: 'Could not load harvest stats.' Buttons on the page: only 'Sign out'.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout; 'Loading stats…' stays forever
findings.steps: Make /api/stats/harvests hang (mocked route that never responds), then change the To date.
findings.expected: After 10 s the request fails and an error with retry is shown.
findings.actual: After more than 13 s the page still showed 'Loading stats…'. No error and no way to retry.
findings.evidence: useApiFetch/useFetch is called without a timeout; seen in the browser.

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently uses the default date
findings.steps: With To set to 2026-09-30, clear the From field.
findings.expected: The field explains that a date is required, or the empty value is handled visibly.
findings.actual: The From input stays blank, but the results silently use 1 Jan of the current year (the server default). The range text says 'from 1 Jan 2026' even though the field is empty.
findings.evidence: After clearing, From value '' while the results text reads '4 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 30 Sept 2026'.
